name: CPU Boost Mode (Aggressive)
description: Enables aggressive CPU boost behavior to prioritize performance under load, which may increase power consumption and heat output.

description_i18n.en: Enables aggressive CPU boost behavior to prioritize performance under load, which may increase power consumption and heat output.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert aggressives CPU-Boost-Verhalten zur Priorisierung der Leistung unter Last, was den Stromverbrauch und die Wärmeentwicklung erhöhen kann.
description_i18n.fr: Active un comportement de boost du processeur agressif pour prioriser les performances sous charge, ce qui peut augmenter la consommation d'énergie et la chaleur.

warnings.title: Power consumption increase
warnings.message: Aggressive CPU boosting may cause higher battery drain on laptops or increased heat generation under heavy workloads

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the processor power settings in Windows by setting both AC and DC value indices to 2 via the powercfg utility
